title: The Secret of the Bed
blurb: Twenty years gone. Penelope sets one last test only the true Odysseus can pass.

characters.name: Penelope
characters.description: Wise, wary, and testing a stranger.

characters.name: Odysseus
characters.description: Home at last, and outraged about furniture.

lines.text: Eurycleia, take the strong bed out of the bed chamber that he himself built.
lines.direction: Cool and calm. Watch him from the corner of your eye.

lines.text: Wife, I am much displeased at what you have just been saying. Who has been taking my bed from the place in which I left it?
I built it myself around the trunk of an olive tree. That is the secret of our bed.
lines.direction: Shape the tree trunk with your hands.

lines.text: Do not be angry with me, Odysseus. The gods have been very cruel to us.
lines.direction: Your guard drops. Step toward him.

lines.text: You have convinced me. It is you. You have come home at last.
lines.direction: Tears of joy. Open your arms.

lines.text: Then come, wife. We have endured so much, and now we are together.

source: Homer, The Odyssey, tr. Samuel Butler (public domain), adapted
